description.zh:
检查项ID。
> 调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
Check item ID.
> Obtain this parameter by calling the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) interface.

description.zh: 查询的任务截止时间的时间戳（毫秒）。
description.en: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of the end time of the queried task.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为zh。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
Language type for request and response messages, default value is zh. Values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh: 查询的任务开始时间的时间戳（毫秒）。
description.en: Timestamp (in milliseconds) of the start time of the queried task.

description.zh:
任务对应的任务类型：
- **REPAIR**：修复任务
- **ROLLBACK**：回滚任务
description.en:
Task type corresponding to the task:
- **REPAIR**: Repair task
- **ROLLBACK**: Rollback task

title.zh: 查看修复或回滚任务的详细信息
title.en: View details of repair or rollback tasks

descriptions.zh: 仅支持购买云平台配置检查授权数或开通云平台配置检查按量付费的用户调用该接口。
descriptions.en: This interface is only available to users who have purchased the cloud platform configuration check authorization or enabled the pay-as-you-go service for cloud platform configuration checks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-operation-check --check-id 23 --operation-task-instances InstanceId=r-bp1642ib4bg2bm0000 Vendor=ALIYUN RegionId=cn-hangzhou --type REPAIR --start-time 1719923175000 --end-time 1719923175001 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListOperationCheck --region cn-hangzhou --Type REPAIR --CheckId 23 --EndTime 1719923175001 --StartTime 1719923175000 --Lang zh --OperationTaskInstances.1.Vendor ALIYUN --OperationTaskInstances.1.InstanceId 'r-bp1642ib4bg2bm0000' --OperationTaskInstances.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
